name: Wildlife Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. GRE policy not established on opened pages.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application review
publishedDeadlines.note: Apply after obtaining faculty adviser agreement; no cycle-specific cutoff stated.

applicationFee.note: Central McNair Scholars/active USU Honors waivers. Some departments offer hardship waivers; Wildland Resources offer unconfirmed. Confirm international category eligibility.

english.note: IELTS each subscale 5; MET 55/Cambridge 176 alternatives. Two-year official scores. Two years of English-instruction college in listed countries exempts. Else official registrar letter/transcript confirming English instruction can satisfy requirement. Program may add conditions.

documents: Official transcripts from prior colleges except USU
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor and GPA 3.0; PhD post-bachelor/master routes. Faculty adviser must agree before application. Recent students: at least two references must authoritatively assess recent academic performance. Recommendations submitted directly. Confirm permission before using unofficial records.

funding.note: Wildland Resources provides no departmental funding. Adviser or third-party support may be available, or students may self-fund. No stipend/tuition guarantee stated.
